why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: Read the geographic restrictions list first. Polymarket blocks 39 countries and prohibits VPN use.
Sign up at polymarket.com with Google, email or a crypto wallet.
Click Deposit, choose a token and network, and send funds to the address shown. Deposits under the minimum stay pending. The help center gives $20 on Ethereum and $3 on Solana as examples.
Trade markets you understand. Polymarket says announcements will only come from its website, its X account and its Discord.
costs: Takers pay a fee on certain markets and makers pay nothing. The fee is highest at a share price of $0.50, where 100 shares cost $1.75 on a crypto market and $1.00 on a politics market. Geopolitics markets are free. Polymarket doesn't charge for deposits or withdrawals.
